title: HOLD-LC-001 source metadata audit with byte and mutation checks
question: Do the locally cached, hash-frozen HOLD-LC-001 products contain enough source metadata to advance the candidate-neutral estimator interface, and can that metadata be audited without promoting header fields to a likelihood, covariance, geocenter correction or candidate score?
method: Run the new audit_hold_lc_metadata.py self-test and production command against the existing byte-freeze manifest, estimator contract and gitignored cache.
Recompute every raw SHA-256 and byte length, parse only compact gzip previews and FITS headers/table-column declarations, and write a bounded tracked metadata report without copying event payloads.
Run an independent PowerShell byte recheck and an independent header-key recheck for the GBM TIMESYS=TT fields and GW 4096-Hz/GPS/duration header lines.
Run a hostile mutation test that changes one expected product hash and require the audit command to exit nonzero; keep all likelihood, covariance, nuisance, map and score fields stopped.
Treat the result as a source/lineage intake advance only; existing T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods, owner order and parked-loop rules remain controlling.

exact_scope.extraction_scope: Raw hash/length recheck, gzip header preview, FITS header and table-column declarations only; no event rows or posterior samples are interpreted as a timing likelihood.
exact_scope.finite_scope: Finite source metadata intake; no continuum, infinite-volume, physical identity or prospective validation claim.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive source-owner intake; no change to T-054/T-059 methods or promotion firewalls.

gw_cleaned_strain.interpretation: Source-product coverage metadata only; detector-to-geocenter calibration and uncertainty remain unadmitted.

table_declarations: trigdat BCKRATES, OB_CALC, MAXRATES and EVNTRATE
gbm_products.interpretation: Available source metadata and table schemas; not a complete timing calibration, geocenter map or covariance.

checks.detail: The FITS card parser and scalar decoder self-test passed before the production audit.
All nine products match the byte-freeze SHA-256 and byte lengths; TT time keywords and table-column declarations are extracted, while likelihood, covariance and all map stages remain unadmitted.
A separate PowerShell implementation recomputed the SHA-256 and byte length for each of the nine products and matched the parent manifest.
A separate PowerShell read found TIMESYS=TT in the five GBM FITS products and the declared GW sample-rate/GPS/duration lines in both cleaned strain gzip files.
Changing one expected parent hash caused the audit command to print FAIL and return nonzero; the mutation was not admitted.
No existing method authority, candidate card, result, negative, physical-empty input or Lean theorem was edited or promoted.

finding: The exact products expose useful source metadata: the cleaned GW files declare 4096 Hz, GPS start and finite duration, while GBM products declare TT-based timing reference fields and event/GTI/response/background/geometry table schemas. This is a reproducible provenance advance, but the products still do not supply a source-owned geocenter conversion with uncertainty, joint timing likelihood, shared covariance or intrinsic-emission nuisance law.
decision_reason: This is a new, bounded source-owner intake result rather than a repeated generic search: raw bytes were independently rechecked, header metadata was extracted by a self-tested parser, and a hostile hash mutation was rejected. The newly observed fields refine the request for missing calibration and statistical ownership but cannot justify candidate scoring or a method change.
decision_scope: Finite retrospective source metadata extraction and integrity checking only; no event-level statistical inference, candidate ranking, dynamics identification, empirical prediction or physical promotion.
assumptions: The byte-freeze manifest remains the authority for product identity, hashes and remote locators.
FITS header and table-column declarations are descriptive metadata and do not encode the complete estimator semantics.
The local cache is ignored and can be reacquired from the parent manifest.
The existing candidate-neutral estimator contract and prospective-lock rules remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned detector-to-geocenter timing conversion and uncertainty.
Frozen timing, background, detector and energy windows with selection semantics.
Joint likelihood or covariance including shared calibration and source terms.
Intrinsic-emission nuisance law or preregistered set-valued scoring rule.
Complete source-owned F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs maps and immutable scorer.

adversarial_review.check: Could TIMESYS=TT be treated as a detector-to-geocenter conversion?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the report records TT as a product time system only and keeps geocenter correction false.

adversarial_review.check: Could a response matrix or background table be treated as timing covariance?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: response/background schemas are recorded as support metadata; component and shared covariance remain NOT_ADMITTED.

adversarial_review.check: Could finite header fields and table declarations be converted into a likelihood without a source statistical owner?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: no likelihood, nuisance law, F_obs map or score is constructed.

adversarial_review.check: Could the selected H1/L1 and N0/B0 subset be called a complete multi-detector analysis?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED-FOR-SCOPE: the audit labels the subset as finite intake and leaves completeness pending.

adversarial_review.check: Could a changed expected hash pass silently?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the hostile mutation test returned nonzero and was rejected.

adversarial_review.check: Could metadata extraction replace the established proof methods?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: T-054/T-059, owner order, parked loops and promotion boundaries remain unchanged.

boundary: EXP-001303 is a T0 source-metadata and integrity advance. It does not admit a likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 exact byte recheck, independently repeated header-key check, self-tested parser and hostile mutation rejection; no model test
next_action: Use the observed header and table metadata to request or locate the missing source-owner calibration, geocenter conversion, window, covariance or likelihood and nuisance specifications; independently reproduce only after those fields are frozen, while continuing unchanged T-054 owner intake.
stop_or_redesign: If no source owner supplies the missing statistical and calibration objects, retain HOLD-LC-001 as provenance/design-only and do not score.
If a future parser needs event-row interpretation, issue a new version with an explicit candidate-neutral selection and error contract.
If a temporal observable is invariant over a static-equivalence class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
If calibration, regulator or nuisance changes reverse a finite verdict, report UNSTABLE_FINITE_ONLY.
If the retrospective packet is used for tuning after target disclosure, do not award prospective credit.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted, selected, ranked, fitted or prospectively validated.
No source-owned likelihood, covariance, nuisance probability law or complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map is present.
Header time keywords and table schemas do not establish a geocenter correction, causal law, QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity identity or microscopic dynamics.
No physical vacuum, Reading-H branch, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The existing T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; this audit is additive and not a replacement.
